pol.no_future_knowledge.description: Historical answers must exclude records known after the knowledge cutoff.

pol.pinned_cut_admission.description: Pinned execution requires complete publications whose knowledge watermark covers the cutoff.

pol.requester_identity.description: Analytical reads use the delegated requester identity; never a broader service principal (ADR-01).

pol.no_cross_subject_reuse.description: Cross-subject cache reuse requires a certified effective-access class.
